question: What reason did Samuel give for the LORD's judgment on Saul?
options: Saul had killed the priests of Nob
Saul did not obey the LORD or carry out His fierce wrath against the Amalekites
Saul had built a monument to himself
explanation: Samuel said, "Because you did not obey the LORD or carry out his fierce wrath against the Amalekites, the LORD has done this to you today."
